title: Among teams that had a player with vision score above 89 in the home_player
question: Among teams that had a player with vision score above 89 in the home_player_8 position in any match, which team lost the fewest home matches during the 2015/2016 season?

prediction.sql:
SELECT t."XCL_173"
FROM "Team" AS t
WHERE t."XCL_171" IN (
    SELECT m."XCL_013"
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN "Player" AS p ON m."XCL_068" = p."XCL_122"
    JOIN "Player_Attributes" AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
    WHERE pa."XCL_147" > 89
)
AND t."XCL_171" IN (
    SELECT m2."XCL_013"
    FROM "Match" AS m2
    WHERE m2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
)
ORDER BY (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM "Match" AS m3
    WHERE m3."XCL_013" = t."XCL_171"
      AND m3."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND m3."XCL_016" > m3."XCL_015"
) ASC
LIMIT 1
